courses.title: 1-on-1 Somatic Work
courses.description: Private sessions on Zoom in which Mary Beth uses body awareness, gentle embodied practice and attention to the nervous system to help a client slow down and notice long-held patterns. Clients choose single sessions or a package of four or six.
courses.price: Single 60-minute session $180.00; 90-minute Deep Dive $275.00; 4-Session Package $680.00; 6-Session Package $990.00

courses.title: The Embodied Return
courses.description: A six-week live online group for women, meeting on Thursdays for 75-minute recorded calls. Each week pairs a short teaching on the nervous system with guided somatic practice, journaling and sharing, moving from feeling safe in the body towards living with more presence day to day.

flags: 1-on-1 Somatic Work: the page names 'motherhood, recovery, grief, burnout, perimenopause' among transitions people come with; no cure or treatment claim, so kept under the new rule.
